findings.title: Tiny final corner steps cancel the remaining route
findings.suggested_fix: Consume reached waypoints without rejecting positive tiny steps or a tiny remaining frame budget; retain focused regressions for both cases and complete the GREEN acceptance run for the root-owned patch.
findings.why_it_matters: A valid route around a floor corner can stop several units before the clicked destination when the final approach to an intermediate waypoint or the remaining frame budget is below 0.00001. Root reproduced both cases in Unity, removed the tiny-movement guard, and started a GREEN run; that result was still pending at review completion.
